name: Wildcat 2 - Z 1 Left - 29 Sweep

FB.rule: Take the snap, drop a step and swing left behind the tailback -- he goes first. Stay behind him until his block is made, then turn it up outside it.

QB.note: You are a wing on this play, not the quarterback -- you line up beside the Z, a step outside him, and you take the outside man. You do not touch the ball.

coaching_points: Wildcat 2 is the fullback at the snap, five yards back. Rep the snap before you rep the play -- a bad snap is the only way this loses yards.
The tailback loads the edge: he goes first, left, and doubles the outside linebacker with the Z. The fullback stays behind them until the block is made.
The quarterback is a wing beside the Z. He does not touch the ball -- tell him before the snap, and tell the defense nothing.
